decision_rules.trim_non_inferior: Per model: new verdict accuracy no more than 10 points below old, and new-vs-old win rate at least 0.40; plus all regression checks pass
decision_rules.fixes_effective: Pooled targeted-insight hit rate (answer-key.json targeted_insights) for new at least 15 points above old
decision_rules.vs_none: Run 13 rules: benefit, neutral, harm or inconclusive
decision_rules.adopt: Commit the trim if it is non-inferior on both models and the regression checks pass; report fixes_effective and vs_none separately

stopping_rule: One attempt per session. No retry on failure. Stop on authentication or quota block. No edits to scenarios, key, grader prompt or skill while sessions run. Record every failure.
limits: Answer key not human-reviewed; run 13 grader calibration also pending
Three samples per cell detect only large effects
Skill answers have a recognisable style, so grading is not fully blind
Claude Code CLI plus one Codex sample

deviation.reason: The entire gap is scenario t04, where trimmed answers labelled the same recommended plan 'investigate' rather than 'park'. Regression checks passed; targeted fixes, insight coverage, trap rate and blind preference over old and over no skill all favoured the trim.
deviation.accepted_costs: More fabricated figures than the old skill on both models; Sonnet selected the skill in about two-thirds of sessions
